reports.title: BJ’s Restaurants, Inc. Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: We are raising certain fiscal year 2026 guidance metrics as follows:

Metric | Prior Outlook: July 30, 2026 | Revised Outlook: November 5, 2026
Comparable Restaurant Sales | Increase 3.0% to 4.0% | Increase approximately 4.7%
Restaurant Level Operating Profit | $228 million to $235 million | $233 million to $237 million
Adjusted EBITDA | $145 million to $152 million | $149 million to $154 million
Capital Expenditures | $85 million to $95 million | Approximately $80 million
Share Repurchases(1) | Up to $50 million | Up to $50 million
